repos.name: odysseus-dev/odysseus
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive, self-hosted AI workspace designed to centralize agentic workflows and local model management.
bullets: Built on a modular Python architecture supporting local LLM integration and persistent memory.
Provides a unified interface for managing agentic tasks, file system interactions, and data processing.
Ideal for developers and researchers requiring a private, secure environment for AI-driven development and automation.
Focuses on data sovereignty and low-latency execution for complex agentic workflows.

repos.name: AgentSafeLabs/safelabs-eval
repos.description: OWASP ASI-aligned red-teaming and evaluation framework for AI agents
repos.one_liner: A specialized red-teaming and evaluation framework aligned with OWASP ASI standards for securing AI agents.
bullets: Utilizes a Python-based testing suite to simulate adversarial attacks against LLM-powered agents.
Maps evaluation metrics directly to OWASP AI Security Initiative (ASI) vulnerabilities.
Essential for fintech and enterprise teams needing to validate agent safety before production deployment.
Automates the detection of prompt injection, data leakage, and unauthorized tool execution.

repos.name: rehan-remade/universal-modder
repos.description: Point Claude at any game. Skills, tools and the fal MCP that let Claude Code mod almost any PC game you own: recon, reverse engineering, fal-generated art/3D/audio, in-game testing, showcase videos.
repos.one_liner: An MCP-powered agentic framework that enables Claude Code to perform automated reverse engineering and game modification.
bullets: Integrates Claude Code with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to interact with game binaries and assets.
Uses fal-AI for generative asset creation, including 3D models, textures, and audio synthesis.
Demonstrates advanced agentic capabilities in complex, non-deterministic environments like PC gaming.
Useful for rapid prototyping of automated software patching and reverse engineering workflows.

repos.name: nicobailon/visual-explainer
repos.description: Agent skill that generates rich HTML pages or slide decks for diagrams, diff reviews, plan audits, data tables, and project recaps
repos.one_liner: An agentic skill that automatically generates rich, interactive HTML visualizations for complex technical data and project audits.
bullets: Uses a lightweight HTML/JS stack to render dynamic diagrams, diff reviews, and data tables.
Acts as a communication layer for AI agents to present complex analytical findings to human stakeholders.
Perfect for quant and fintech reporting where transparency in agentic decision-making is critical.
Supports automated generation of slide decks and project recaps directly from agent logs.

repos.name: PSRben/VisionHOPE
repos.description: Official PyTorch implementation of VisionHOPE: Visual Backbones as Self-Modifying Learning Systems.
repos.one_liner: A PyTorch implementation of self-modifying visual backbones that adapt their architecture during the learning process.
bullets: Implements dynamic neural network structures that evolve based on input data characteristics.
Leverages PyTorch for high-performance tensor operations and gradient-based architectural updates.
Represents a frontier approach to computer vision, potentially reducing the need for massive static pre-training.
Applicable in high-frequency visual analysis tasks where model efficiency and adaptability are paramount.
